info.title: gemini-to-api - OpenAI, Claude and Gemini compatible APIs backed by the Gemini web app
info.description: Local OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible API server backed by the Gemini web app and your browser session.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Capture the Gemini cookie from your browser (Windows)

options.name: --browser
options.description: chrome | edge | firefox  (default: first installed, in that order)

options.name: --browser-path
options.description: use this browser executable (any OS)

options.name: --no-auto-message
options.description: never send a message; wait for you to use Gemini instead

options.name: --message
options.description: message sent to trigger a request (default "What's 1+1?")

options.name: --timeout
options.description: give up after this long (default 10)

options.name: --browser-args
options.description: extra command-line arguments for the browser (e.g. a proxy)

options.name: --keep-open
options.description: leave the browser running afterwards

options.name: --no-verify
options.description: don't test the captured cookie against Gemini

options.name: --print
options.description:
also print the captured values
Credentials captured by `login` are stored in <data dir>/credentials.env and used by `serve`.

options.name: --port
options.description: PORT                     (default 4981)

options.name: --host
options.description: HOST                     (default localhost; 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)

options.name: --cookies
options.description: GEMINI_COOKIES           full Cookie header from gemini.google.com

options.name: --auth-user
options.description: GEMINI_AUTH_USER         account slot from /u/<n>/ URLs

options.name: --refresh-interval
options.description: GEMINI_REFRESH_INTERVAL  (default 1440, minimum 10)

options.name: --max-retries
options.description: GEMINI_MAX_RETRIES       (default 3)

options.name: --temporary
options.description: GEMINI_TEMPORARY=true    don't keep conversations in Gemini history

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API_KEY                  require this key from API clients

options.name: --log-level
options.description: LOG_LEVEL                debug | info | warn | error

options.name: --env-file
options.description: read settings from this file instead of ./.env

options.name: --data-dir
options.description: GEMINI_TO_API_HOME       (default ~/.gemini-to-api)
